description: This file defines utility functions and classes for working with key-value stores (KVStore) within Apache Spark's status module, including opening, creating, serializing, and iterating over KVStore data, with support for different backends like LevelDB and RocksDB.

classes.name: KVStoreScalaSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class for KVStore that supports Scala types and removes JSON string length limitations.

classes.name: MetadataMismatchException
classes.description: Exception thrown when there is a metadata mismatch in KVStore.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens or creates a disk-based KVStore with specified metadata and configuration.

methods.name: serializerForHistoryServer
methods.description: Selects the appropriate serializer for the history server based on configuration.

methods.name: createKVStore
methods.description: Creates or opens a KVStore at a specified path, handling version mismatches and errors.

methods.name: viewToSeq
methods.description: Converts a KVStoreView to a Scala sequence with optional filtering and slicing.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts elements in a KVStoreView satisfying a predicate.

methods.name: foreach
methods.description: Applies a function to all elements in a KVStoreView.

methods.name: mapToSeq
methods.description: Transforms all elements in a KVStoreView to a sequence using a mapping function.

methods.name: mapToSeqWithFilter
methods.description: Transforms and filters elements in a KVStoreView, returning a sequence.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in a KVStoreView.
